institution: Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences, Lucknow (Neonatology)
citation: SGPGIMS Hospital Infection Control Committee (SHICCOM). Hospital Infection Control Newsletter: Healthcare without infection, Volume 4, January to June 2022. Spotlight, Neonatology: antibiogram of bacterial pathogens recovered in blood cultures of IPD patients (January to June 2022). Lucknow: SGPGIMS.
reporting: Percent susceptible for bacterial pathogens from blood cultures of Neonatology IPD patients, with the number of isolates per organism; "-" means not tested.
method: First isolate from any sample only; diagnostic isolates, not surveillance; drugs routinely tested. AST method and breakpoints not stated.

verification.note: Both tables and the Fig 2 organism counts on p 1 read from the PDF text layer (word positions per column) and compared value by value with the rendered page image (2026-09-26).

notes: Unit antibiogram of the Department of Neonatology, SGPGIMS Lucknow: blood cultures of IPD patients, January to June 2022 (33 positive blood cultures: 17 Gram positive, 16 Gram negative), from the SHICCOM Hospital Infection Control Newsletter. IPD is mapped to wards as printed; the unit is neonatal, and the document does not separate the NICU. Every organism has fewer than 30 isolates (the newsletter itself notes the 30-isolate minimum).
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: every cell of Tables 1 and 2 (p 1) re-read by eye from page renders (scale 5, the data rows again at scale 8) and written down before comparing with the file: all 47 cells, all 5 row n (13, 3, 9, 4, 1) with organism, specimen and setting, and all 6 counts (Fig 2 legend). 0 transcription errors, nothing corrected. CoNS levonadifloxacin 61 is printed and rightly listed in excluded (no drug key); "-" cells rightly left out.
Second reader: the 2 intrinsic cells are printed that way: E. faecalis gentamicin 66 and A. baumannii ertapenem 0.

Second reader: setting as printed: the heading says "blood cultures of IPD patients (January-June 2022)" in the Neonatology section; neither NICU nor ICU appears anywhere in that section, and there is no separate ICU column or table, so IPD here is every Neonatology inpatient and does not exclude a NICU. Set left as ward, as the extractor set it; inpatient (IPD and ICU together) would be the stricter reading of the setting keys (lead's decision).

Lead 2026-09-26: a single-department antibiogram, given a focus ("Covers the neonatology department (neonatal inpatients) only"): shown, never pooled with hospital-wide antibiograms, not a profile. "IPD" read as all neonatal inpatients (setting inpatient; no NICU column exists), 5 rows.
